origin.description: Build a progression handler that reports nothing.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is 0.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "void".

arguments.name: enable
arguments.text: If FALSE, the handler is a no-op. The default is FALSE.

origin.details: The initiate, update, and finish reporters return NULL. Nothing is written.
origin.example:
handler <- handler_void(enable = TRUE)
value <- with_progress({
  p <- progressor(steps = 2, on_exit = FALSE)
  p(message = "a")
  p(message = "b")
  6
}, handlers = handler, enable = TRUE, interval = 0, delay_terminal = FALSE, delay_stdout = FALSE, delay_conditions = character())
cat("handler_void returns ", value, " and writes nothing.\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Build a progression handler that reports nothing.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is 0.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "void".

arguments.name: enable
arguments.text: If False, the handler is a no-op. The default is False.

translation.details: The initiate, update, and finish reporters return None. Nothing is written. Pass enable=True to install the reporters; the factory still calls them only while the handler is enabled.
translation.example:
from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.progressor import progressor
from progressr.reporters import handler_void

handler = handler_void(enable=True)

def body():
    progress = progressor(steps=2, on_exit=False)
    progress(message="a")
    progress(message="b")
    return 6

value = with_progress(body, handlers=handler, enable=True, interval=0, delay_terminal=False, delay_stdout=False, delay_conditions=())
print(f"handler_void returns {value} and writes nothing.")
